description: Every Respond.io feature, plus an offline mirror and SQL that answers inbox questions no single API call can.

novel_features.name: Inbox workload overview
novel_features.description: One-command summary of open conversations, unassigned contacts, per-agent distribution, and recent activity.

novel_features.name: Channel mix report
novel_features.description: See which messaging channels (WhatsApp, Instagram, email...) your contacts actually use.

novel_features.name: Workload by agent
novel_features.description: Per-agent message and conversation handling volume from the synced workspace.

novel_features.name: Tag cohort segments
novel_features.description: List every contact that carries a given tag (VIP, unpaid, in-trial).

novel_features.name: Custom-field gaps
novel_features.description: Find contacts missing a custom field value (e.g. no orderId or region).

novel_features.name: Idle follow-up
novel_features.description: Find unassigned contacts with no recent activity worth working.

novel_features.name: Offline contact search
novel_features.description: Free-text search across synced contacts without hitting the API.
